title: Soil Health
message: Use organic compost to improve soil fertility.

title: Irrigation
message: Avoid overwatering to prevent root damage.

title: Pest Control
message: Use neem oil as a natural pesticide.

title: Crop Rotation
message: Rotate crops to maintain soil nutrients.

title: Harvesting
message: Harvest crops at the right time for best quality.

title: Market Prices
message: Check market prices before selling your produce.

title: Fertilizer Use
message: Use fertilizers according to soil test results.

title: Disease Management
message: Remove infected plants to prevent disease spread.

title: Sustainable Farming
message: Adopt sustainable practices for long-term benefits.

title: Water Conservation
message: Use drip irrigation to save water.

title: Seed Selection
message: Choose high-quality seeds for better yields.

title: Weed Control
message: Mulch around plants to suppress weeds.

title: Livestock Care
message: Provide clean water and shelter for livestock.

title: Farm Safety
message: Wear protective gear when handling chemicals.
